purpose: Measure whether frozen V3 trajectory-aware relevance improves coding-agent outcomes or context allocation on effort-heavy historical bugs selected treatment-blind by the difficulty screen.

primary_outcome.name: paired_task_success
primary_outcome.definition: Oracle PASS/FAIL for one fresh OFF and one fresh ON agent session per hard task.

secondary_agent_efficiency.interpretation: Request, search, token and wall-time differences are descriptive because OFF and ON agent trajectories are stochastic.

mechanism_metrics.historical_critical_evidence: Production records adjacent to the historical fixing change that are present in the naturally retrieved raw search result. This label does not imply causal necessity.
mechanism_metrics.matched_historical_critical_recall: For the same raw search target and same captured inbound trajectory, fraction of historical-critical records retained after OFF versus frozen V3 replay.
mechanism_metrics.critical_record_rescue_rate: Among records dropped by OFF, fraction retained by V3 (D->K).
mechanism_metrics.critical_record_regression_rate: Among records retained by OFF, fraction dropped by V3 (K->D).
mechanism_metrics.bridge_conditioned_noncritical_token_bur: For matched bridge-relevant search units, retained compressed tokens excluding retained historical-critical evidence tokens.
mechanism_metrics.noncritical_suppression_gain: (OFF non-critical retained tokens - V3 non-critical retained tokens) / OFF non-critical retained tokens.
mechanism_metrics.bridge_evidence_efficiency: Historical-critical records retained per 1000 retained non-critical tokens.
mechanism_metrics.treatment_reachability: Number of ON tasks and search units where trajectory relevance actually activates.

matched_replay_policy.unit_population: Naturally occurring search units that can be paired to an exact captured inbound request. Critical-recall analysis further requires at least one historical-critical record in raw target.

causal_language_policy.if_off_and_on_both_pass: Do not claim task-success improvement. Evaluate efficiency and matched evidence allocation instead.
